feed_description: A personalized daily news briefing across BJJ/grappling, soccer, financial freedom, and NJ local news.

topics.label: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling
topics.brief: Top headlines in Brazilian jiu-jitsu and submission grappling: major tournament results (ADCC, IBJJF Worlds/Pans, ONE Championship, Who's Number One, Polaris, Fight to Win), notable matches and upsets, rule changes, big athlete moves or injuries.

topics.label: Global & European Soccer (Atlético Madrid emphasis)
topics.brief: Top headlines in global and European soccer/football. Give special emphasis to Atlético de Madrid (match results, transfer news, injuries, manager/coaching news), but also cover major European leagues and competitions broadly (Champions League, La Liga, Premier League, etc.).

topics.label: Financial Freedom & Markets
topics.brief: News useful to someone working toward financial independence: what's driving overall stock market moves; specific news on VTI (Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF), SPOT (Spotify), and AAPL (Apple) stock; cost-saving news relevant to families and homeowners in New Jersey (utility rates, property taxes, mortgage/refinance rates, insurance); practical investing tips or strategies.

topics.label: NJ Local News (Montclair emphasis)
topics.brief: Local New Jersey news, with special emphasis on Montclair, NJ. Prioritize upcoming local events relevant to a family with a 12-year-old son, and to these interests: food, movies, soccer, auto/motorsport racing, tennis, sci-fi/fiction, meditation, and mountain biking.
